subject: A note about BYM2 CAR models in Nimble

messages.author: 35cf403e5052bfe0
messages.subject: A note about BYM2 CAR models in Nimble
parts:
For those interested in new spatial models in Nimble, there is now nimble code for
the BYM2 model with scaled precisions of Reibler et al (2016).
This can be downloaded from
https://github.com/Andrew9Lawson/Bayesian-DM-code-examples

The file bym2_sc_scaling.txt contains full working code which calls the INLA function inla.scale.model

Ref: Riebler, A., Sorbye, S. H., Simpson, D. and Rue, H. (2016)
"An intuitive Bayesian spatial model for disease mapping that accounts for scaling".
Statistical Methods in Medical Research. 25(4): 1145-1165
